positioning.methodology: Spec-Kit (Specification-Driven Autonomous Multi-Agent Synthesis with Deterministic CI Verification Gates)

governance_layer.description: Version-controlled constraints every AI agent reads before writing code. This is the mechanism behind the Zero AI Slop guarantee.
spec_pipeline_stages: Specify - define WHAT, technology-agnostic, in specs/<feature>/spec.md
Clarify - resolve ambiguity and edge cases back into the spec
Plan - define HOW: architecture, data model, API contracts, trade-offs
Generate tasks - ordered, dependency-aware task list
Analyze - review tasks against migration safety, tenancy and permissions before coding
Implement - execute against the spec, then run the verification suite

merge_gate.policy: No test, no merge. All checks must pass before an agent may report a task complete.
merge_gate.self_review: 7 questions answered in writing and posted as a comment on every pull request
